title: Homilies on Exodus, Homily 6
blurb: Origen’s Homily 6 on Exodus (Rufinus’s Latin). Complete on this page: §§1–14.
first_english_note: Original English Translation of Origen’s Homily 6 on Exodus — no previous public-domain English (ANF lacks these homilies; Heine FOTC 71 is copyrighted and was not used as wording). This page is Homily 6 §§1–14 (closeout). The English here is new.

text_history.method: English follows Baehrens, Origenes Werke VI (GCS 29, 1920), Rufinus’s Latin of Homily 6. Heine FOTC 71 was not used as wording. This page is Homily 6 §§1–14 (closeout).
